EloMatchResult.luau.description: Elo Match Result provides the class/model implementation used by the Elo package.

EloMatchResultUtils.luau.description: Elo Match Result Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Elo package. Public entry points include `EloMatchResultUtils.isEloMatchResult`, `EloMatchResultUtils.isEloMatchResultList`.

EloUtils.luau.description: Utilities to compute elo scores for players Public entry points include `EloUtils.createConfig`, `EloUtils.isEloConfig`, `EloUtils.getStandardDeviation`, `EloUtils.getPercentile`, `EloUtils.percentileToElo`, `EloUtils.getNewElo`, `EloUtils.getEloChange`, `EloUtils.getNewPlayerOneScore`.
